meta.specName: WiseWheel — Service-Call Management System — Rebuild Specification
meta.purpose: Complete, field-accurate blueprint to rebuild the app from scratch in React + Vite (vanilla JS/TS, NO Next.js) with a LOCAL JSON database that is later swappable for MongoDB Atlas with zero UI changes. Deployable to Netlify for testing. Must stay fast and smooth for 100-200+ concurrent users.
meta.productDescription: A multi-tenant SaaS for micro-mobility repair shops (scooters / e-bikes). Each business (tenant) gets an isolated environment with an admin dashboard, a customer self-service portal, a public repair-request form, and a mobile driver pickup panel. A super-admin console provisions tenants.
criticalConstraints: UI must be reproduced 1:1 from the design system below — Tailwind utility classes only, no custom CSS beyond base bg/text colors.
Data layer MUST go through a single repository/adapter interface so the JSON backend can be replaced by MongoDB without touching components.
Base64 images are stored INSIDE records — they MUST be excluded from all list/collection reads and fetched on demand only, or the app becomes slow. This is the #1 performance rule.
Every entity is scoped to a tenantId; nothing crosses tenants.

targetTechStack.framework: React 19 + Vite (SPA, vanilla — no Next.js, no SSR)
targetTechStack.icons: lucide-react (NEVER emoji as functional icons; emoji allowed only as decorative inline text as in the original)
targetTechStack.state: React hooks + a thin data-repository layer (React Query / SWR recommended for caching & 100+ user smoothness)
targetTechStack.imageProcessing: Client-side canvas resize+compress to WebP before upload/store (replaces server-side sharp). Target max 1280px longest edge, quality ~0.7.
targetTechStack.buildOutput: Static SPA + serverless API functions under /api (Netlify Functions)

multiTenancy.model: Path-based. Every app URL is prefixed by /:tenantId (a lowercase-alphanumeric slug, regex ^[a-z0-9]+$).
multiTenancy.isolation: Each tenant = its own logical database/namespace. In the JSON phase: one JSON file (or one top-level key) per tenantId. In the Mongo phase: one Mongo database per tenantId (as in the original). A master/global store holds the tenants registry.
multiTenancy.guard: Reject any tenantId not present in the tenants registry (prevents arbitrary namespace creation).

layers: UI components (React) — never talk to storage directly
Data repository interface (see dataRepositoryInterface) — the ONLY seam the storage backend plugs into
Serverless API routes (Netlify Functions) mirroring the endpoints list — thin wrappers over the repository

rules: Never ship base64 image fields in list responses — use projection/exclusion. Load a single record's images only when a detail modal opens.
Paginate service-request lists (default limit 100, page param).
Create DB indexes on: id (unique), customerId, driverId, requestNumber(desc), createdAt(desc) per collection.
Run independent reads in parallel (Promise.all), not sequentially.
Cache tenant settings & customer/driver lists client-side; pass them into joins instead of re-fetching.
Lazy-load images in the browser (loading="lazy"), thumbnails via a dedicated image endpoint.

Counter.desc: Atomic sequence generator. One doc per sequence: {_id: 'requestNumber'|'partRequestNumber'|'orderNumber', seq: number}. In JSON phase, increment in a locked/serialized write.

phase1_json.goal: A drop-in JSON-backed implementation of dataRepositoryInterface that runs behind Netlify Functions (or, for pure client testing, in-memory + localStorage).
storageOptions: Netlify: use @netlify/blobs (persistent) — the function filesystem is read-only/ephemeral on Netlify, so do NOT rely on writing db.json at runtime in production.
Local dev: a lowdb-style JSON file works fine.
Client-only demo: localStorage/IndexedDB seeded from a bundled seed.json.
phase1_json.seed: Reuse existing db.json (customers + serviceRequests) as a seed sample for one tenant. Note base64 images inflate the file — keep seed images small.
phase1_json.concurrencyNote: Serialize writes per tenant (simple mutex/queue) so counter increments and array writes don't race under 100+ users.

phase2_mongo.goal: Swap JSONAdapter → MongoAdapter with identical method signatures.
phase2_mongo.mapping: master_db.tenants (registry); one Mongo db per tenantId with collections customers/drivers/serviceRequests/partRequests/orders/counters.

dataRepositoryInterface.desc: The single seam. Components call these; only the adapter changes between JSON and Mongo. All methods are tenant-scoped (first arg tenantId) except tenant registry methods.
tenants: getTenantsWithPasswords(): Tenant[]  // super-admin only, keeps adminPasswordPlain
customers: deleteCustomer(tenantId, id): boolean  // ALSO deletes that customer's serviceRequests
drivers: deleteDriver(tenantId, id): boolean  // unassigns (never deletes) requests+orders that referenced it
serviceRequests: getServiceRequests(tenantId, {page,limit,excludeImages,customers?,drivers?}): {requests, total}  // paginated; excludeImages projects out all base64 fields
getServiceRequestById(tenantId, id): ServiceRequest?  // WITH images (detail modal, on demand)
createServiceRequest(tenantId, payload): ServiceRequest  // auto requestNumber; auto-assign driver if exactly 1 driver exists
markRequestsPickedUpWithSignature(tenantId, requestIds[], driverId, {signatureImage, photoImage?, signerName, conditionNotesMap?}): number  // sets status=PICKED_UP_BY_DRIVER + pickup fields
orders: createOrder(tenantId, {customerId, deviceType, quantity, unitPrice}): Order  // computes totalPrice, status=PENDING

superAdmin.method: email + password against env vars SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL / SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD

tenantAdmin.method: password only, checked against tenant.adminPassword (scrypt hash). Supports legacy plaintext with re-hash on success.
tenantAdmin.session: cookie 'admin_session', HMAC-signed, tenantId + exp, 7-day max age
tenantAdmin.hashing: scrypt (keylen 64), format scrypt$salt$hash. No external deps.

driver.method: secret token in URL = driver.id (UUID). No password. Route /:tenantId/driver/:token.

deployment.spa: Vite build → static output; add netlify.toml redirects so all non-/api routes serve index.html (client routing).
deployment.persistenceWarning: The Netlify function filesystem is read-only at runtime — for the JSON phase use @netlify/blobs (or Mongo) for writes, not a runtime-written db.json.

acceptanceCriteria: Every screen, field, label, placeholder, and status listed here is present and in Hebrew/RTL.
Design matches design-system/DESIGN_GUIDE.md exactly (colors, radii, shadows, spacing, recipes).
List views never transfer base64 images; detail views load images on demand.
Storage backend is swappable JSON↔Mongo via dataRepositoryInterface with no component changes.
Deploys to Netlify and stays smooth for 100-200+ concurrent users.
Multi-tenant isolation enforced; tenantId validated against registry.
